bio: As the Adams House Administrator, I manage House room placements and the housing lottery, finances, special events, and work closely with the Faculty Deans, Allston Burr Resident Dean, Academic Coordinator, and Building Manager on other House projects. I really enjoy promoting House community and pride through special events, intramural competition, House traditions, or building connections with people around Adams House. I started at Harvard and Adams House in July 2018 after working at Boston College for 4 years. Outside of work, I love to ski, play basketball, golf, watch football, travel, and spend time with my friends and family. Community Adams House Area Residential Life
